$comment: How Epoch AI's ML hardware dataset (https://epoch.ai/data/ml_hardware.csv, CC BY) names the cards of hardware.json. scripts/sync/epoch.mjs reads it: 'map' pairs an Epoch 'Hardware name' with a hardware.json id (values are cross-checked), 'ignore' lists NVIDIA rows deliberately left out of the catalog, with the reason. Any other NVIDIA row is reported as a new card. A name in 'map' that Epoch no longer lists is reported too (renamed upstream?).

ignore.NVIDIA HGX H20: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA H800 SXM5: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA A800 SXM: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA A800 PCIe 40 GB: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA A800 PCIe 80 GB: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA L2 PCle: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA L20 PCle: China export variant, not sold here
ignore.NVIDIA GH100: the die, not a product (the H100 cards are in the catalog)
ignore.NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070: 12 GB consumer card, too small for the models planned
ignore.NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080: 16 GB consumer card, superseded by the RTX 5080 in the catalog
ignore.NVIDIA L40: superseded by the L40S in the catalog
